summary: The note tier now escapes the group's own words before putting them in a prompt, like every other renderer already did.
details: Neither note adaptor escaped anything. The curator interpolated a note's title, body, uncertainty and closing condition — and members' own messages — straight into a <note> tag it built around them, so a message containing a closing tag could end that block early and one containing an opening tag could add a note nothing wrote.

This matters most in the curator because it is the only destructive writer in the background tier: it retires notes and discharges claims into memory. Its grounding check refuses a forged citation id and says nothing about a forged block.
The candidates pass had the same gap. Its lines are not inside a tag, but the notes index is appended to the same prompt directly beneath them.
Found by an audit of the whole tier against the repo's own comprehend-measure-serialize rule, not by an incident.
limitations: Escaping is the fix for forging a block. It is not a fix for a member writing something persuasive inside a message the model was legitimately shown — that remains the model's judgement, as it is everywhere else.
Neither adaptor's blocks carry the untrusted marker its siblings do; that is a prompt change the note-candidates suite would need to grade, and was left out of this fix.
